{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

print(f'Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicate_patients)}')
print(f'Patients with multiple rows: {list(duplicate_patients.index)}')

# Check how many rows have biomarker_baseline == -999
missing_baseline = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
total_rows = len(df)
print(f'Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {missing_baseline}')
print(f'Proportion: {missing_baseline / total_rows:.2%}')"}
